title: Daphnetin alleviates neuropathic pain in rats by modulating spinal microglial polarization via the Nrf2/NLRP3 inflammasome pathway.
authors: Liang, Wulin; Zhang, Mingqian; Cheng, Lu; Huang, Zhishan; Zhang, Liyuan; Tan, Qiling; Liu, Wenling; Cheng, Zhenzhen; Zhang, Chao; Dong, Shifen; Tang, Minke; Zhang, Yi; Jia, Zhanhong
one_liner_zh: 该文研究Daphnetin通过Nrf2/NLRP3通路调节脊髓小胶质细胞极化缓解神经病理性疼痛，虽含分子对接与MD模拟，但核心是药物-蛋白互作而非蛋白质-DNA互作，与本课题无关。
abstract: BACKGROUND: Neuropathic pain (NP) is a frequent sequel to peripheral nerve injury and maladaptive nervous system function. Daphnetin (DAP), a bioactive 7,8-dihydroxycoumarin derived from the traditional Chinese medical plant Daphne giraldii Nitsche, has potential anti-nociceptive effects and alleviated NP following intrathecal injection. However, the molecular target of DAP for this action remains unknown. PURPOSE: This study aims to investigate the underlying mechanisms of DAP against NP. METHODS: Chronic constriction injury (CCI) rat model and lipopolysaccharide (LPS)-treated HAPI microglial cells were established to evaluate the analgesic and anti-inflammatory effects and underlying mechanisms of DAP. Rat behavioral assessments included mechanical withdrawal threshold (MWT), thermal withdrawal latency (TWL), and gait analysis. The expression of mRNA was determined by qRT-PCR. Protein expression levels were detected by Western blot, immunofluorescence, and enzyme linked immunosorbent assay. Molecular docking, surface plasmon resonance, molecular dynamics simulation, and site-directed mutagenesis were employed to investigate the interaction between Kelch-like ECH-associated protein 1 (Keap1) and DAP. RESULTS: DAP treatment significantly increased MWT and TWT in CCI rats. It also improved gait parameters and attenuated spinal inflammation, neuronal damage, and hyperexcitability in CCI rats. DAP treatment markedly increased the expression of Nrf2 and its nuclear translocation in the rat spinal cord and HAPI cells. DAP treatment inhibited the activation of NLRP3 inflammasome and microglial M1 phenotype polarization, while promoting M2 phenotype polarization. Furthermore, the NLRP3 inhibitor MCC950 also alleviated hyperalgesia in CCI rats, inhibited NLRP3 inflammasome activation, suppressed microglial M1 polarization, and promotes M2 polarization, whereas the Nrf2 inhibitor ML385 exerted the opposite effect. It reversed the regulatory effect of DAP on spinal microglial polarization in the CCI rat spinal cord and LPS-induced HAPI cells. Molecular interaction studies further demonstrated that DAP binds to Tyr334 and Tyr572 residues in the Kelch domain of Keap1, thereby blocking Keap1/Nrf2 interaction to activate Nrf2. CONCLUSION: DAP treatment inhibits microglial M1 polarization and promotes M2 polarization via the Nrf2/NLRP3 inflammasome pathway, attenuates neuroinflammation and central sensitization, and finally achieves analgesic effects. These findings identify DAP as a novel Nrf2 activator with therapeutic potential for the management of NP.
abstract_zh: 背景：神经病理性疼痛（NP）是周围神经损伤和神经系统功能适应不良的常见后遗症。瑞香素（DAP），一种源自传统中药植物祖师麻（Daphne giraldii Nitsche）的生物活性7,8-二羟基香豆素，具有潜在的抗伤害性效应，并在鞘内注射后缓解了NP。然而，DAP此作用的分子靶点仍未知。目的：本研究旨在探讨DAP对抗NP的潜在机制。方法：建立慢性压迫性损伤（CCI）大鼠模型和脂多糖（LPS）处理的HAPI小胶质细胞，以评估DAP的镇痛和抗炎效应及其潜在机制。大鼠行为学评估包括机械 withdrawal 阈值（MWT）、热 withdrawal 潜伏期（TWL）和步态分析。mRNA表达通过qRT-PCR测定。蛋白表达水平通过Western blot、免疫荧光和酶联免疫吸附测定检测。采用分子对接、表面等离子体共振、分子动力学模拟和定点突变研究Kelch样ECH相关蛋白1（Keap1）与DAP之间的相互作用。结果：DAP治疗显著增加了CCI大鼠的MWT和TWT。它还改善了步态参数，并减轻了CCI大鼠的脊髓炎症、神经元损伤和过度兴奋性。DAP治疗显著增加了大鼠脊髓和HAPI细胞中Nrf2的表达及其核转位。DAP治疗抑制了NLRP3炎症小体激活和小胶质细胞M1表型极化，同时促进M2表型极化。此外，NLRP3抑制剂MCC950也减轻了CCI大鼠的痛觉过敏，抑制了NLRP3炎症小体激活，抑制了小胶质细胞M1极化并促进M2极化，而Nrf2抑制剂ML385则产生相反效应。它逆转了DAP对CCI大鼠脊髓和LPS诱导的HAPI细胞中脊髓小胶质细胞极化的调节作用。分子相互作用研究进一步证明，DAP结合到Keap1 Kelch结构域中的Tyr334和Tyr572残基，从而阻断Keap1/Nrf2相互作用以激活Nrf2。结论：DAP治疗通过Nrf2/NLRP3炎症小体通路抑制小胶质细胞M1极化并促进M2极化，减轻神经炎症和中枢敏化，最终实现镇痛效应。这些发现将DAP确定为一种新型Nrf2激活剂，具有治疗NP的潜力。
